description: Delays a signal by a fraction of the time between two clock ticks

params.text: Sets the fraction of a clock tick the signal is held back by, in sixteenths
Adds or takes away up to 1000ms on top of the fraction

inputs.text: The clock whose tick-to-tick time the fraction is measured against

outputs.text: The signal from the input, held back

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
